The person asks:
When do I have to object to the 2025 service-charge statement?

response.text:
You have until **Fri 10 Sep 2027** to raise objections to the 2025 service-charge (Betriebskosten) statement from Wohnbau Musterstadt eG [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].

- This is 12 months after you received the statement (10 Sep 2026), per § 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB as quoted in the letter, with the deadline computed under §§ 187/188/193 BGB [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- Ordnung recommends sending your written objection by **Sun 6 Sep 2027** to allow time for it to arrive [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- The task: notify the landlord in writing of any objections to the cost figures before the deadline [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- You can draft the letter in Ordnung ("Draft letter") when you're ready.
